title: Head of Teaching Assistants - YAKA / ACU Program
description: Led the national team of 67 TAs and supervised 5 intensive coding bootcamps (Java, C++, JS, C/Bash, SQL) and 7 large-scale projects (compiler, HTTP server in C, malloc, POSIX shell) for 700+ 3rd-year students across 5 campuses. Implemented 1-on-1 code review mentorship model, improving TA-to-student ratio from 1:30 to 1:20.
